about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (layout files, artwork, footprint geometry), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (what the manufacturer builds from a gate run: Gerber layers, drill hits, BOM and CPL rows). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (U1 T-Display pinout and the project-library footprint, C1 polarity, the 5 mm LEDs' polarity at their footprints, J1 servo pinout, the THT buttons) checked a second time independently against datasheet and footprint – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer
manual.note: M-1: OK for state 0bd61e5f…; requirements met: R-7, R-12, R-34. Second check on 2026-11-01 (edakit bc44fa7). U1's footprint_data equals esp32's but for the layer key, matches the dump esp32tht.geometry.json (holes 1.1 mm plated) and LILYGO's pin map and KiCad footprint (22.86 mm rows, 5V and 3V3 squares at the USB end). Pins = main.cpp and firmware.json; IO2/IO12/IO15 not connected. XL-504SYGD (datasheet sha256 9efbedbe… = verified): long lead = anode, pad 1 with the flat on GND as for the XL-504SURD/UYD. C1, J1 and the C110153 buttons as on tht. R-7 as on esp32. Notes as on esp32.

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability; hand soldering; mechanics: USB at the edge; operation of the buttons; looks of the LED row) on the manufacturing files of a gate run – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer
manual.note: M-5: OK for fab hash 02441da3… (gate run 20261101-004536, edakit bc44fa7). Against the reviewed b768d2f5… (20261031-154618/-160323), edakit fab diff shows only the new order.json; every Gerber layer, the drill file, BOM and CPL are equal, and the board never had an order-number placeholder. Order: JLCPCB, 2 layers, 1.6 mm, green/white, LeadFree HASL, Remove Mark, PCB only (no assembly, no tooling holes). Stage L warnings only D-21 (1) on S1/S2 as extended by D-23.

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the stated purpose (RoHS, REACH, radio, batteries, product safety) – the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session; support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed
manual.note: M-6: OK for state 668320d0… (electrical) and purpose private; requirements met: R-10, R-33. Wi-Fi only on channels 1–13 (2412–2472 MHz): the firmware sets country DE with 802.11d off after every mode change and turns the radio off if that fails; the module's own antenna at default power, at most 20.5 dBm − 4.32 dBi ≈ 16.2 dBm e.i.r.p. against 20 dBm; no Bluetooth; powered only through the T-Display's USB-C, no cell at the module's battery input, no mains. D-36 settles the CE-marking condition of Austria's FMaG 2016 § 24: the radio equipment in service is the unmodified, CE-marked T-Display (the owner checks the mark on arrival, else Wi-Fi stays off). Notes: the ground copper under the antenna end is not checked (3.8 dB margin); erase the home Wi-Fi password before the module leaves the house; RoHS, REACH, WEEE and a CE marking of the bell itself do not apply to own use. Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed.

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: board preview and price (bare board, no assembly)

Acceptance of every soldered board: visual check, T-Display plugged in, current through USB, every LED, both buttons, the servo swings, the display shows the countdown; Wi-Fi: the setup hotspot Glocke-XXXX on channels 1–13 with WPA2, the page at glocke.local, no Bluetooth device of the bell; the module marked T-DISPLAY V1.1
